name: William Walker Young
notes: Bill Young was employed at the CNR (Carman, upholsterer)in 1934.  He served overseas with the Cameron Highlanders, was wounded in Dieppe & then returned for the second front.He saw the war to its conclusion in 1945.He was very interested in the bagpipes & was a longtime member of the Pipes & Drums unit of Khartum Temple.Bill was ill for many years of his later life suffering from emphysema.
